evidence.quoted_text:
base.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        require(not base.stat().st_mode & 0o077,
                "private record directory must have mode 0700: " + str(base))
        name = ("run-" + time.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ", time.gmtime())
                + "-" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:6])
        self.run_dir = base / name
        self.run_dir.mkdir(mode=0o700)
evidence.reason: The current `claim_run_dir` creates the record base and then `self.run_dir` but never fsyncs the record base (or, when the base was newly created, its parent) before returning the claimed run directory. Since `durable_write` only syncs the receipt inside the run directory, a crash can lose the run-directory entry while the host has already been admitted/held, losing the recovery state. This is a concrete durability defect in the existing recovery flow, not merely a new requirement.
